craft_i18n.desc: Shared translations for the storytold Crafting Apps: TSV catalogs and the CI that checks them

icu.role: CLDR/Unicode formatting, plural rules, datetime, collation (ICU4X)

fluent.role: Mozilla Fluent asymmetric grammar & gender/plural messages

best_practices_2026: Store canonical catalogs in sorted, diff-friendly TSV (craft-i18n) or Fluent (.ftl) with CI validation for missing/duplicate keys and placeholder parity
Use ICU4X (icu 2.4.0 + icu_locale 2.4.0) for locale-aware numbers, dates, and plural categories; never hand-roll plural logic
Detect runtime locale via sys-locale with explicit fallback chain (requested -> OS -> en)
Keep zero hardcoded user-facing literals in Rust UI/CLI code; enforce via CI lint + automated rewrite script (tools/i18n-audit.rs)
